title: My Card Says We Stop Being FRIENDS ✉️
description:
Everybody here gets one card at eighteen that says how their closest friendship ends. The cards are never wrong.

Mine says my best friend Maya and I stop being friends at 9:14 tonight. On the back, in tiny writing, it says it won't hurt.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment CARD if you'd want to read yours.
